subject: Conditional credit offer for LaunchReady cohort — Stellari request
messages:
From: LaunchReady Accelerator <apply@launchready.org>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Stellari — cohort credit request and usage snapshot

Hi Irene,

I'm reaching out from LaunchReady — Stellari Health was accepted into our fall cohort and they're asking if Redwood can provide a conditional credit offer to support their pilot through Q1. They estimate ~1.2M tokens during the 90-day cohort (proof attached).

Short version of the ask:
- 90-day trial/top-up: $8k equivalent in Redwood credits (tokens + embeddings)
- Option to extend for another 90 days contingent on reaching metrics

Stellari (Ravi Sharma, cc'd) is running an on-device + cloud hybrid inference flow and flagged Redwood's cost/latency benchmarks as a reason they want to use our platform for the cohort. They asked for a formal approval letter for procurement.

I've attached their accelerator application and a usage snapshot. Can you confirm next steps and timeline for approvals? LaunchReady typically needs a signed letter before the cohort kickoff on Oct 26.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Maya Patel
Program Manager | LaunchReady Accelerator
apply@launchready.org

Attachments:
- launchready-application.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: LaunchReady Accelerator <apply@launchready.org>, Ravi Sharma <ravi@stellari.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stellari — cohort credit request and usage snapshot

Thanks Maya — and hi Ravi.

Appreciate the context and the attachments. Two quick clarifying questions before I loop in Finance for a formal letter:
1) Is the 1.2M token estimate primarily generation or embedding calls? (embeddings scale differently in billing).
2) Do you expect any PII/processors to be sent to hosted Redwood endpoints, or will this be purely a dedicated/private deployment during the cohort?

If you can reply with a 1-paragraph usage breakdown, I can get a conditional approval path started. If everything looks standard, we can provide a credit letter and a 90-day extension with an opt-in clause for an additional 90 days based on agreed milestones.

Putting Karthik on CC to help with timing and the approval template.

Warmly,
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, LaunchReady Accelerator <apply@launchready.org>, Ravi Sharma <ravi@stellari.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stellari — cohort credit request and usage snapshot

Thanks Irene / Maya — reviewed the application and usage snapshot. Initial read: the ask is reasonable for a cohort engagement and fits our startup program guardrails.

Proposal for approval path:
- In-principle: 90-day $8k credit (deal id DL-2026-7361) as Redwood Hosted credits
- Milestone: 45-day usage check — if they hit >=50% of estimated consumption, auto-extend an additional 90 days with matching credits subject to manager sign-off
- Requirements: signed credit letter and a short MOU acknowledging usage telemetry sharing for billing reconciliation

Action items for us: Irene to draft the credit letter; Marissa to confirm final sign-off and any exceptions to the Hosted vs Dedicated deployment. Finance will need a quick usage CSV (suggested attached).

I've attached a usage snapshot export we typically use. Tagging Marissa for the final go/no-go on the extension language.

- Karthik
Head of GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, LaunchReady Accelerator <apply@launchready.org>, Ravi Sharma <ravi@stellari.co>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stellari — cohort credit request and usage snapshot

Hi team — reviewed DL-2026-7361 and the proposed path. Approve in principle with the following conditions:
- Provide 90-day $8k hosted credit, issued as account credits to Stellari's Redwood account (account id in HubSpot).
- Auto-extension clause is conditional: extension requires a short report at day 45 and explicit manager approval (Marissa). No automatic unconditional top-up.
- For procurement: we'll issue a signed credit-approval-letter.pdf and include a short appendix with data retention and SLAs for hosted usage.

Irene — please prepare the letter using the standard template and include the HubSpot deal link. Finance needs the usage CSV for internal tracking (I see one attached). I am comfortable with Hosted credits for this cohort given the short duration; if Stellari requests Dedicated during the cohort we'll evaluate separately.

Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments included for signing:
- credit-approval-letter.pdf
From: Ravi Sharma <ravi@stellari.co>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, LaunchReady Accelerator <apply@launchready.org>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stellari — cohort credit request and usage snapshot

Amazing — thank you all. Stellari accepts the 90-day $8k hosted credit and will prepare the 45-day usage report template. We'll sign the approval letter as soon as it's ready.

Two quick asks from procurement side:
- Can the approval letter include a clause referencing our PO number? (we'll provide it after acceptance)
- Any chance we can get the signed letter by Oct 20 so procurement can get it processed before cohort start?

Otherwise happy to proceed — Ravi
Ravi Sharma
Co-founder & CTO | Stellari Health
ravi@stellari.co
